summary: Read the inventory module. In ensureInventoryLevels (packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts, ~lines 173-191), the validateQuantityAtLocation loop checks each batch entry against the same static level.available_quantity and never subtracts what earlier entries in the same batch claimed. createReservationItems_ then persists the summed adjustment for each (item, location). This matches the bug report's per-line-check defect: two entries for one inventory item in one batch can jointly over-reserve stock. I submitted one attempt (cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 sharing WIDGET, 12 units vs 10 stock) expecting no_oversell to fail; the run results were not returned to me, so the claim rests on the source reading rather than an observed failure.
